Ava (People Ops): Heads-up: urgent water-main repair discovered under the SF hub basement. Restrooms on levels 1-4 and the pantry will be out of service for today. Hub remains open with limited amenities. Please read for alternate workspace and support options. :droplet:

Ava (People Ops): TL;DR: restrooms/pantry closed today (est. 12h), bottled water & porta-potties outside, complimentary drop-in passes at nearby coworking partner for today only, $10 remote-work stipend if you choose to stay home, visitor prereg still required. Links: coworking sign-up https://redwood.internal/forms/coworking-today

Marco (Facilities): Repair crew on site now. We expect repairs complete by 20:00 but will update if timeline changes. Elevator access unaffected, but please avoid basement and server-closet areas.

Sofia (Eng): If my team needs to run a hardware test that requires sinks / water (lab), what do we do?

Marco (Facilities): Lab access limited. If you require on-site lab use, DM me with exact equipment and time; we can arrange a monitored slot in the battery-backed test room or coordinate on-site technician support.

Dan (Sales): I have a customer meeting in the afternoon  can we use the coworking partner space for the demo?

Ava (People Ops): Yes, customer-facing meetings can be moved to the coworking partner (short notice approved). Please book via the link and mark "customer-demo" so we prioritize rooms; badge & NDA rules still apply.

Security Bot: Note: temporary security escort required for external guests while crews are on site. Badge pickup remains at lobby. All visitors must be preregistered 2h ahead for this event.

CoWork Partner: Reminder to guests: bring company ID for check-in. Were providing 20 drop-in passes (first-come). Food & coffee available on-site.

Ava (People Ops): Remote stipend: $10 for folks who decide to work from home today; submit expense with tag "water-closure-2026" by EOD. If you need childcare or accessibility help because of this disruption, DM me and well help coordinate. Updates will be posted here; thank you for bearing with us. :heart:
